symptom: `mxcli run --local --db-type hsqldb` on a Mendix 9.24 app failed in mxbuild's Gradle 7.6 with "Unsupported class file major version 65": mxcli resolved JDK 21 and skipped a JAVA_HOME pointing at JDK 17, and the JDK-not-found hint suggested `alter settings runtime ( JavaVersion: '21' )`, which no-ops on 9.x
cause: `ProjectJavaMajor` fell back to a flat `DefaultJavaMajor = 21` whenever the model stores no JavaVersion — but a Mendix 9 model never stores one (the setting does not exist before 10.x), and 9.x supports Java 11/17 only. The detect.go hint fired for any major != 21, including 9.x's 17
insight: "Setting absent" meant "use the platform default" only while every supported version shared one default; once a version range without the setting has a different JDK, the fallback has to be keyed on the Mendix version, which the reader already has (`ProjectVersion().MajorVersion`). The committed 9.24.30 fixture (modelsdk/mpr/testdata/v1-project) made this testable without mxbuild. Revert proof: ProjectJavaMajor(9.24 fixture) = (21, false), want (17, false)
